uutiset.t: China a 'Supersized' Testing Ground for Technology: Xi
uutiset.s: Xi Jinping tells Asia-Pacific business leaders that China aims to drive high-quality growth through innovation, green transition and closer integration of technological and industrial development. uutiset.t: Xi Calls for Deeper Cooperation and Free Trade
uutiset.s: Xi Jinping says Asia-Pacific economies should expand trade and bilateral relations while recognizing their differences in history, culture and development. He speaks at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Rupee Forwards Turn More Bullish Than Currency Forecasters
uutiset.s: Forward-implied USD/INR rate for end-2026 is about 94.32 per dollar.

uutiset.t: Iron Ore Likely to Find a Floor Near $80, Chinese Analysts Say
uutiset.s: Iron ore prices will need to drop to about $80 a ton before high-cost mines start cutting output to put a floor under the market, according to Chinese analysts.

uutiset.t: Xi Warns Against ‘Rampant’ Protectionism Ahead of Trump Talks
uutiset.s: Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific economies to deepen cooperation as he warned against rising unilateralism and protectionism, setting out a defense of free trade as China hosts global leaders for high-stakes talks on trade and technology.

uutiset.t: Japanese Restaurant Skylark Eyes More M&A After Ramen Chain Deal
uutiset.s: Skylark Holdings Co., one of Japan’s largest restaurant chains, plans more M&A in 2027, and expects its growth-investment budget to match at least this year’s ¥50 billion ($313 million), according to company management.

uutiset.t: Cobalt’s Outlook Darkens as Memory Chip Costs Hit Gadgets Demand
uutiset.s: Chinese cobalt demand is weakening as soaring prices for memory chips hit sales of the electronic gadgets that use the battery metal.

uutiset.t: Ping An Group To Reduce Public Equity Allocation
uutiset.s: Michael Guo, Ping An Group Co-CEO says the insurance company is planning to reduce allocation on public equity and considering fixed income as an alternative investment. He speaks to Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle in an exclusive interview at the APEC 2026 summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Quant Trader Graviton Expands Office Space in India, Singapore
uutiset.s: Graviton Research Capital LLP has expanded into larger offices in India’s high-frequency trading hub of Gurugram and in Singapore as the homegrown firm gears up for an ambitious global expansion.

uutiset.t: China Sets Strongest Yuan Fixing Since 2022 as APEC Begins
uutiset.s: China’s central bank lifted its daily yuan reference rate to the strongest in over four years, a sign of tolerance for gradual gains as the nation hosts a key regional summit.

uutiset.t: SQM Sees Positive Lithium Demand Outlook Even as Prices Slide
uutiset.s: Major lithium producer SQM continues to see “encouraging trends” in underlying demand as the industry confronts a renewed selloff in the battery metal and the prospect of rising supply next year.

uutiset.t: David Jones to Cut 1,500 Jobs in Survival Fight, Union Says
uutiset.s: Australian department store chain David Jones is set to cut about 1,500 jobs, one-quarter of the workforce, as it shuts outlets in a bid to survive, according to the employees’ union.

uutiset.t: Thailand Sees US Chip Curbs as Risk to Data Center Drive
uutiset.s: New US restrictions on the export and access to top-end semiconductors risks denting Thailand’s ambitions to be a hub for data centers, the foreign minister said. uutiset.t: China Bank Rally Gains Momentum as Global AI Trade Unravels
uutiset.s: Chinese bank stocks are gaining a tailwind as turmoil around Nvidia Corp. deepens cracks in the artificial intelligence trade and drives investors toward defensive bets.
